tier.description: 1 = canonical APT values (exclusions only); 2 = own palette with APT semantic token names and contrast; 3 = guidance only, no checks.

css.description: Stylesheet that defines or @imports the theme tokens, relative to the repository root.

themes.description: Theme block selectors. Omit to auto-detect (.light => :root dark; .dark => :root light).

exclusions.description: Tier 1 tokens allowed to differ from canonical values. Each needs a reason and a decision record.

decision.description: Path to the decision record accepting the exclusion.

roots.description: Folders scanned for raw colors (default apps/web/src).

allowlist.description: Files where literal colors are data, not styling.

baseline.description: Lint findings accepted while a repo cleans up (mainly Tier 2). The check fails above it and asks for it to be lowered when findings fall below it. Default 0.
